 TIMESTAMP(objcreated, 0) AS created, objsize, days_used_count, objlongschema, text,
 sql_object_type
FROM TABLE(qsys2.object_statistics(
  object_schema => ?, objtypelist => '*ALL', object_name => '*ALL'))
WHERE last_used_object = 'YES' AND (sql_object_type = 'TABLE' OR objattribute IN ('PF', 'LF')) AND
  objcreated < current_timestamp - ? MONTHS AND (last_used_timestamp IS null OR
    last_used_timestamp < current_timestamp - ? MONTHS)
ORDER BY COALESCE(last_used_timestamp, objcreated) ASC

SELECT T.TABLE_SCHEMA,
       T.TABLE_NAME,
       T.TABLE_TYPE,
       T.TABLE_TEXT,
       COALESCE(S.NUMBER_ROWS, 0) AS NUMBER_ROWS,
       T.COLUMN_COUNT
FROM QSYS2.SYSTABLES T
LEFT JOIN QSYS2.SYSTABLESTAT S
  ON T.TABLE_SCHEMA = S.TABLE_SCHEMA
  AND T.TABLE_NAME = S.TABLE_NAME
WHERE T.TABLE_SCHEMA = UPPER(?)
  AND T.TABLE_TYPE IN ('T', 'V', 'P')
  AND (? = '*ALL' OR T.TABLE_NAME LIKE UPPER(?))
ORDER BY T.TABLE_TYPE, T.TABLE_NAME
FETCH FIRST 200 ROWS ONLY

  SQL_STATEMENT => ?,

)) AS P

SELECT
  'SELECT * FROM ' || TRIM(T.TABLE_SCHEMA) || '.' || TRIM(T.TABLE_NAME) ||
  ' FETCH FIRST ' || CAST(? AS VARCHAR(10)) || ' ROWS ONLY' AS SAMPLE_QUERY,
  T.TABLE_SCHEMA,
  T.TABLE_NAME,
  COALESCE(S.NUMBER_ROWS, 0) AS TOTAL_ROWS
FROM QSYS2.SYSTABLES T
LEFT JOIN QSYS2.SYSTABLESTAT S
  ON T.TABLE_SCHEMA = S.TABLE_SCHEMA
  AND T.TABLE_NAME = S.TABLE_NAME
WHERE T.TABLE_SCHEMA = UPPER(?)
  AND T.TABLE_NAME = UPPER(?)
  AND T.TABLE_TYPE IN ('T', 'V', 'P')
FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY

  COALESCE(O.OBJSIZE / 1024, 0) AS SIZE_KB,
  O.LAST_USED_TIMESTAMP,
  O.DAYS_USED_COUNT,
  COALESCE(S.NUMBER_DELETED_ROWS, 0) AS DELETED_ROWS,
  S.LAST_CHANGE_TIMESTAMP,

  OBJECT_SCHEMA => UPPER(?),
  OBJTYPELIST => '*FILE',
  OBJECT_NAME => UPPER(?)
